summary.headline: Lord of the Second House
summary.text: Interpretations of a planetary lord’s placement in the fifth through twelfth houses, covering children, servants, infirmity, women, inheritance, faith, pilgrimage, principality, friends, enemies, and victory. Chapter IX then begins the significations of the lord of the second house in the twelve houses, through its placement in the sixth.
